# NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Ben Mildenhall, Pratul P. Srinivasan, Matthew Tancik, Jonathan T. Barron, Ravi Ramamoorthi, Ren Ng  
**Year:** 2020  
**Journal:** ECCV  
**DOI:** [10.1007/978-3-030-58452-8_24](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-58452-8_24)  
**Publisher:** [https://www.matthewtancik.com/nerf](https://www.matthewtancik.com/nerf)

**Keywords:** nerf, novel view synthesis, 3d

## Abstract

We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing a continuous 5D neural radiance field.
